source.title: Seven new models at scalable price-performance
source.author: gmays

title.zh: Microsoft MAI模型：七款新品主打性能价格比
title.en: Microsoft MAI Models: Seven New Releases at Lower Cost

excerpt.zh: Microsoft MAI模型家族推出七款新品，覆盖编程、网络安全、图像、语音和决策等任务；微软强调以较低价格扩大部署，但其性能与成本比较仍主要来自公司披露的评测。
excerpt.en: Microsoft MAI models expand across coding, cybersecurity, image, voice, and decision tasks. Microsoft highlights lower deployment costs, but the performance and price comparisons rely largely on company-reported

text.zh: Microsoft MAI模型家族一次推出七款新品，覆盖编程、网络安全、图像编辑、实时语音、转录和决策等用途。微软把核心卖点放在可扩展的性能价格比，希望让企业能够更频繁地运行智能体，而不必承担同等能力大型模型的高昂调用成本。
text.en: Microsoft has introduced seven additions to its MAI model family, spanning coding, cybersecurity, image editing, real-time speech, transcription, and decision-making. The central pitch is scalable price-performance: enabling enterprises to run agents more often without paying the same usage costs associated with larger models.

text.zh: MAI模型覆盖多种企业任务
text.en: MAI models target a range of enterprise tasks

text.zh: 新品中，MAI Code 2面向日常企业编程，微软称其在指定基准测试中的表现接近GPT-6.1 Sol，价格约为其四成；Code 2 Flash则瞄准高频、常规代码任务。MAI Cyber 2 Flash用于持续网络防御，MAI Image 2.7侧重图像编辑，MAI Realtime 1支持实时语音对话，Decision 1.1则用于在应用中选择模型。Dragon Copilot Transcribe基于MAI Transcribe 2，微软称其已用于每月一千万次患者就诊的转录。
text.en: MAI Code 2 targets everyday enterprise programming. Microsoft says it approaches GPT-6.1 Sol on selected benchmarks at about 40% of the price, while Code 2 Flash is aimed at frequent routine coding tasks. MAI Cyber 2 Flash is intended for ongoing cyber defense; MAI Image 2.7 focuses on image editing; MAI Realtime 1 supports live speech conversations; and Decision 1.1 routes model use within applications. Dragon Copilot Transcribe, based on MAI Transcribe 2, is reported to handle transcription for 10 million patient encounters each month.

text.zh: 微软还宣布第二代Maia 200 AI加速器已进入生产阶段，并称其运行大型模型时每瓦令牌数提升至前代的1.7倍。此外，MAI Licensed Weights允许客户在自有Azure环境中定制和运行授权模型，微软表示客户可控制访问权限，并保留其数据与定制成果。
text.en: Microsoft also says its second-generation Maia 200 AI accelerator has entered production, delivering 1.7 times as many tokens per watt when running its largest models. Separately, MAI Licensed Weights is intended to let customers customize licensed models and run them in their own Azure environments, with control over access and retention of their data and adaptations, according to Microsoft.

text.zh: 价格优势仍需独立验证
低成本可能让企业扩大智能体和模型服务的使用范围，但公告中的性能排名、价格比例和业务成效均来自微软披露，且依据不同基准或内部评测，不能直接视为跨任务的普遍结论。微软也明确指出，Code 2尚未针对基础科学研究或超长周期智能体任务优化。企业评估时仍需比较实际工作负载下的质量、延迟、安全表现与总成本；公告提供了有吸引力的起点，却没有替代独立测试。
text.en: Lower costs could make broader use of agents and model services more practical. However, the rankings, price ratios, and operational outcomes in the announcement are Microsoft-reported and draw on different benchmarks or evaluations, so they should not be treated as universal comparisons across tasks. Microsoft also says Code 2 is not yet tuned for fundamental science research or very long-horizon agent work. Businesses will still need to test quality, latency, security, and total cost on their own workloads. The launch offers a useful starting point, not a substitute for independent evaluation.
